events.speaker: CLEO
events.text: Sit still and I'll give you the closest, cleanest shave this side of Griffin. Free, first time -- call it advertising.

events.speaker: CLEO
events.text: There. Clean shave, and the most useful thing you've heard all week, free of charge.

events.speaker: CLEO
events.text: A place, and an ear for whatever this outfit needs to know. Fair trade.

events.speaker: CLEO
events.text: I read people while my hands are busy. Took me longer than usual to read you.
